description: The plot illustrates how accuracy varies with different values of “o_pop frequency (x10^4)” for two series labeled “Initial Accuracy” and “Final Accuracy.” The x-axis is labeled “o_pop frequency (x10^4),” uses a linear scale, and shows discrete tick values from 1 to 19 at an interval of 2 (1, 3, 5, …, 19). The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0.0 to 1.0 with regularly spaced ticks at 0.2 intervals. The “Initial Accuracy” line is green with square markers and a solid line, with vertical error bars at each point; it starts near 0.34 at x=1, rises to about 0.50 at x=5, drops to about 0.30 at x=7, increases to about 0.52 at x=13, then declines to about 0.36 at x=17 and ends around 0.40 at x=19. The “Final Accuracy” line is blue with circular markers and a dashed line, also with vertical error bars; it begins around 0.65 at x=1, increases to about 0.86 at x=5, dips to about 0.72 at x=7, peaks near 0.92 at x=9, falls to about 0.70 at x=13, rises again to about 0.90 at x=15, dips to about 0.82 at x=17, and ends near 0.90 at x=19.
